title: 500. Encode N-ary Tree to Binary Tree

examples.explanation: Encoding to binary and decoding restores the grouping.
The deeper structure is preserved through both conversions.

hints: Parse the N-ary string with a queue, one null-delimited group per node.
Encode: first child goes left, next sibling goes right, recursively.
Decode by reversing that mapping, then serialize canonically.
